findings.evidence: Diff: pre-PR `theorem indFDRepMap_id`/`indFDRepMap_comp` and `@[expose, simps obj map] noncomputable def indFDRepFunctor` (with the docstring stating expose is what makes `indFDRepFunctor.obj A` reduce to `indFDRep A`); head lines 381, 393, 409, 426-433. No user of these names exists elsewhere in the repo (grep over `TauCeti/` returns only this file), so the laws are now unreachable downstream except through the cast-laden 426.
findings.fix: Drop `private` from `indFDRepMap_id`/`indFDRepMap_comp` and restore `@[expose, simps obj map]` on `indFDRepFunctor`, deleting the hand-written `indFDRepFunctor_obj`/`indFDRepFunctor_map` with their `eqToHom` transports.
findings.issue: `indFDRepMap_id` (381) and `indFDRepMap_comp` (393) were public before this PR and are now `private`. Since an `@[expose]` body may not reference private declarations, this forces `indFDRepFunctor` to stay opaque, which is why `indFDRepFunctor_map` (426) is now stated with two `eqToHom` casts and proved by `rfl` (relying on proof-irrelevance defeq) instead of the pre-PR `@[expose, simps obj map]` projection `indFDRepFunctor_map f = indFDRepMap f`. Nothing in the universe split requires this: the cast-free statement elaborates in-file, where the functor body is transparent.

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/Rep/Basic.lean:157,169` state `mkIso_hom_hom_apply`/`mkIso_inv_hom_apply` for `Rep.mkIso e`, whose head cannot match `(indFDRepForgetIso A).hom`; head lines 318, 325 mark the local replacements `private`, while `indFDRepForgetIso` is used outside the file at `TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Induction/FrobeniusReciprocity.lean:102,128`.
findings.fix: Make both lemmas public (and tag them `@[simp]`), so `indFDRepForgetIso` has a usable interface rather than being a black box outside this file.
findings.issue: `indFDRepForgetIso` (311) is public but opaque, and its only action lemmas `indFDRepForgetIso_hom_hom_apply` (318) and `indFDRepForgetIso_inv_hom_apply` (325) are `private`. Mathlib's `Rep.mkIso_hom_hom_apply`/`mkIso_inv_hom_apply` cannot fire on the opaque def, so no downstream proof can compute with the isomorphism at all — the same gap that made this file need the two lemmas internally at line 378.

summary: The prior round's rfl-bridge and misattributed-change findings are fixed. Remaining issue: the functor laws and the only projection lemmas for the public `indFDRepForgetIso` were made `private`, which forced dropping `@[expose, simps obj map]` and degraded `indFDRepFunctor_map` into an `eqToHom`-laden statement proved by `rfl`.
